lane_boundary: All sibling lanes are advisory only. No sibling lane output closes GMUT gates or validates physics.

app_lanes.summary: Proposed field lists for baseline equations, reference state, expected output, source anchors, term manifests, comparison boundary, residual tolerance, switch leakage, and open-gate carry.
strong_points: Global required fields include execution_status:not_run, result_status:no_result, claim_ceiling:fixture_precondition_only, source_authority, next_missing_artifact, and six_gate_status:all_open.

Global forbidden fields include fixture_result, recovery_result, validation_status, canon_promotion_status, fifth_force_safety_status, consciousness_proof_status, final_physics_status, and gate_closed.
Exact refusal language should state that fixture execution is refused until all precondition artifacts are locally bound.

app_lanes.summary: Defined exactness criteria, contradiction checks, hard locks, and refusal wording for schema/refusal discipline.
strong_points: Baseline exactness requires local artifact, equation set, convention card, active/disabled/held terms, and comparison scope.
not_run/no_result hard locks are mandatory and contradict PASS, recovered, validated, safe, closed, or confirmed wording.
B_Psi remains demoted unless a separate definition artifact exists, and V(Psi) remains symbolic unless a specified potential artifact exists.

app_lanes.summary: Outlined closed-schema artifact families, forbidden fields, and schema/lint validation hooks.
strong_points: Schema lint rejects unknown fields and result synonyms.
Gate lint fails if any gate verdict is not OPEN_NOT_TESTED.
Source-to-claim lint fails if source authority cannot support the claim class.

cli_lanes.summary: Returned prompt-bounded rules for row identity, order invariance, gap taxonomy, literal/derived separation, conflict protocol, no-execution protocol, confidence bands, claim endcaps, source route codes, and source-bounded verdict.
usable_points: Row identity should be a stable source-anchored tuple rather than row number or render order.
Order invariance should be multiset equality over normalized row identities.
Claim endcaps should explicitly state support, limit, and non-implications.

cli_lanes.summary: Returned criteria for ledger shape, normalized keys, presence and uniqueness guards, provenance triples, null semantics, witness bundles, refusal vocabulary, unsupported authority, comparison leakage, authority conflict protocol, and open-gate narration.
usable_points: Presence should be tri-state: present, absent, not_checked.
Provenance triple should include source_kind, source_locator, and derivation_mode.
Open-gate narration should state what was checked, what was not found, what would count as closure evidence, and why the gate remains open.

consensus_points: v5_x1 should define precondition artifacts only, not execute fixtures.
execution_status:not_run and result_status:no_result must remain hard locks.
All six GMUT gates remain OPEN_NOT_TESTED.
Baseline equation, reference state, and expected output must be exact local artifacts before fixture execution.
Source anchors must be local and exact where exactness is claimed.
Term manifests must separate active, absent, disabled, held, quarantined, and symbolic terms.
Residual tolerance must be pre-execution only until units, thresholds, and comparison mode exist.
Switch-leakage must track full scalar disablement and not treat coupling-to-zero as sufficient.
B_Psi remains quarantined or demoted without a definition artifact.
V(Psi) remains symbolic without a potential and derivative rule artifact.
Journey/Solas context is journey_context_not_canon and cannot validate GMUT.
v5_x2 should synthesize a refusal-first exactness ledger and blocker-indexed schema map.
